name: Elena Beatriz Sosa
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally a meticulous restorer of classic cars, her keen eye for detail and steady hand caught the attention of a local racing team struggling with inconsistent paint finishes. She transitioned to motorsport, initially focusing on minor repairs and touch-ups before mastering the intricacies of high-performance automotive coatings. 

Now at RSC Motorsport, Elena prides herself on delivering flawless paintwork that not only looks stunning but also contributes to the vehicle's aerodynamic efficiency. She's known for her no-nonsense approach, demanding absolute precision from her team and personally inspecting every panel before it leaves the shop. Her dedication to quality has earned her the respect of drivers and engineers alike. What sets Elena apart is her ability to blend traditional techniques with modern materials, ensuring a finish that is both durable and visually striking.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled in a short, practical bob
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a strong, determined face and kind eyes that reflect years of experience.

quirks: Always wears protective gloves, even when doing paperwork.
Has a collection of vintage paint mixing tools that she occasionally uses.
Insists on listening to tango music while working to maintain concentration.
